nodes.label: KPR Primary Service Icon (256px)
nodes.description: 3D-style glossy icon: white house with royal-blue roof, chimney, four-pane window and blue door, with a large blue key in the foreground and a blue shrub. Transparent background, 256px service icon asset.

nodes.label: KPR (Home Ownership Loan) Service
nodes.rationale: House-plus-key motif is the conventional visual metaphor for obtaining home ownership via mortgage (KPR = Kredit Pemilikan Rumah); blue palette aligns with the primary brand color.

nodes.label: Blue Glossy 3D Service Icon Style
nodes.rationale: Consistent monochrome-blue, soft-gradient 3D illustration style used for service icons so the icon set reads as one family.
